title: Average Credit Score Change From the Medical-Debt Reporting Fix

source.name: Medical Debt Burden in the United States

notes: CFPB estimated the medical-debt credit-reporting changes raised scores for an estimated 16 million Americans, by an average of about 20 points, with no debt actually repaid. Recalled from CFPB's published estimate; not live-refreshed this run because outbound network access was unavailable in this session.
